situation: I'm Tessa, a Year 5 teacher, and I've just joined a running club's WhatsApp group, about 40 people, after coming to their Saturday runs for a month. I'm slow, about 6:40 per km, and training for my first half marathon, Brighton in March. Want to say hi.
reply: Hi all, I'm Tessa, just joined after tagging along on the Saturday runs for a month. I'm training for my first half, Brighton in March, and I'm firmly at the back at about 6:40 per km. Off the track I teach Year 5, so I'm good at herding and less good at speed. Anyone else doing Brighton, or up for a slow Sunday long run?
note: Stating the pace up front invites the right people to reply.

situation: I'm Rohan, taking over a client account from my colleague Beth, who left on Friday. I've run paid search for retail brands for four years and I've read all her campaign notes. I play cricket in Leyton on Sundays. Need to introduce myself by email to the client's marketing team.
reply: Hi all, I'm Rohan, and I'm taking over as your account manager from Beth, who left on Friday. I've spent four years running paid search for retail brands, and I've read every campaign note Beth left, so nothing resets. Outside work I'm usually on a cricket pitch in Leyton on Sundays. Could we do 30 minutes next week so you can tell me what's working and what isn't? Tuesday or Thursday afternoon both suit me.
note: For a handover, the reassurance that nothing resets is the one thing they most need to hear.

situation: I'm Kwame, a new PhD student in Professor Lindqvist's lab in Uppsala, just arrived from Accra, where my master's was on soil microbes under drought; here I'll move to root imaging on the confocal. I have to introduce myself at the lab's first group meeting, about 30 seconds, spoken.
reply: Hi, I'm Kwame, first-year PhD with Professor Lindqvist. I did my master's in Accra on soil microbes under drought, and I'm here to take that into root imaging. I'm also new to Uppsala and to proper winters, so advice on what to wear is very welcome. And whoever runs the confocal bookings, I'd love ten minutes with you.
note: The coat line is the hook people will actually use to start a conversation.

situation: 我叫刘婧，是医院药剂师。儿子周子航刚转学到三年级二班，我们上个月从成都搬到杭州，他特别爱踢球。我被拉进了家长群，两百多人，想发个自我介绍，不想太长也不想像打广告。
reply: 各位家长好，我是新转来的周子航的妈妈刘婧。我们上个月刚从成都搬到杭州。我在医院做药剂师，孩子用药方面有拿不准的可以问我。子航特别爱踢球，周末要是有小朋友在小区踢，欢迎叫上他！
note: 家长群里先说清是谁的家长，给一个真能帮上忙的点，再留一个让人容易接话的邀请。

situation: I'm Nadia, starting Monday as engineering manager for a payments team of 7, after five years leading a checkout team at Larkfield. Their last manager left suddenly and one of them applied for my job. Outside work I climb and bake bad sourdough. I want to post a short hello in the team Slack on day one.
reply: Hi all, I'm Nadia, and from today I'm managing the payments team. I spent the last five years leading the checkout team at Larkfield, so I know how much of this work is invisible until it breaks. Outside work I'm usually at the climbing wall or failing at sourdough. I'll book 30 minutes with each of you over the next two weeks, and mostly I want to hear what's working that I shouldn't touch.
note: New manager of an inherited team: signal listening over change, and don't single out the internal candidate in a group post.

situation: 我叫陈晓，木工学徒出身，在家具厂设计部做了三年实木餐椅。公司新成立酒店家具项目组，拉了生产、销售、采购十几个同事进企业微信群，我调过来负责设计对接，很多人我只在食堂见过。想发个自我介绍。
reply: 各位好，我是设计部的陈晓，从今天起在酒店家具项目组负责设计对接。我在设计部做了三年实木餐椅，木工学徒出身，所以画图时会先想一遍车间能不能做出来。很多同事之前只在食堂见过，以后碰到欢迎直接叫我。生产和采购的同事，过去哪张设计图让你们最头疼，麻烦私信告诉我，我想先从那里改起。
note: 内部调岗进新项目组：大家可能见过你但不了解你，说清你负责什么，再问一个能马上开始干活的问题。

situation: I'm Lena Novak, a freelance developer in Bristol, six years in, mostly bakeries and cafés; my latest job, online ordering for three Bristol bakeries, now takes 40% of their orders. I'm on a panel about small-business websites at a local meetup on Thursday Oct 15, and the organiser wants a third-person bio under 60 words. I've kept a sourdough starter alive since 2019.
reply: Lena Novak is a freelance web developer who has spent six years building sites for bakeries, cafés and other small food businesses. Her latest, an online ordering system for three Bristol bakeries, now takes 40% of their orders. She lives in Bristol with a sourdough starter she has kept alive since 2019.
note: A bio still needs one concrete result and one human hook; the hook is what the moderator will use to introduce you.

situation: I'm Priya, a freelance UX designer and a bank teller for three years before that. I'm starting a 10-week redesign of a regional credit union's mobile app, after similar work for two other credit unions. Kickoff video call is Thursday Oct 1 with about eight of their people, most new to outside designers; I get about a minute to introduce myself.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Priya, and I'll be leading the design on the app redesign for the next ten weeks. I've done similar work for two other credit unions, and the thing I care most about is that your members can still find their balance without thinking a year from now. Before design I was a bank teller for three years, so I've heard every complaint about banking apps in person. I'll be asking a lot of questions this week, and none of them are traps. If there's one thing members call you about more than anything, I'd love to hear it today.
note: With a client team wary of outsiders: one relevant credential, one human hook that shows you get their members, and an invitation to talk.

situation: Started yesterday as operations manager at a warehouse, the third one in two years. I posted a short hello in the team WhatsApp and one of the shift leads, Gary, replied 'Another new manager, let's see how long this one lasts 😂'. A few people laughed. How do I answer?
reply: Ha, fair, three managers in two years would make me skeptical too, Gary. I'm planning to stick around long enough to get annoying. Since you've watched all three of us come and go, what's the one thing on the floor you'd fix first? Happy to hear it over a coffee this week.
note: Take the jab lightly, agree with the true part, and make the skeptic the first person whose opinion you ask for.

situation: 佐藤美穂です。10月1日（木）に中途入社して、営業企画部に配属されます。前職は食品メーカーで6年間、スーパー向けの販促企画をしていました。休日は多摩川沿いを走っていて、11月のハーフマラソンに向けて練習中です。初日に部署の約30人へ自己紹介メールを送る予定で、堅すぎず、でも失礼のない感じにしたいです。
reply: 営業企画部の皆さま、本日より営業企画部に配属となりました佐藤美穂と申します。前職では食品メーカーで6年間、スーパー向けの販促企画を担当し、売場ごとの数字とにらめっこしてきました。休日は多摩川沿いを走っていて、11月のハーフマラソンに向けて練習中です。早く皆さまのお仕事を知りたいので、ランチなどでお話を聞かせていただけたら嬉しいです。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
note: 丁寧語は守りつつ、具体的な仕事の話を一つ、人柄が見える話を一つ、最後に声をかけやすい誘いを入れる。

situation: 我叫林晓，之前在城东中学带过两届初中生，刚接手初一（3）班当班主任，教语文，打算每周五留一篇短文。平时爱打羽毛球。第一次在班级家长群（45位家长）发自我介绍，想简短亲切，也让家长知道工作日下午4点后可以私信我。
reply: 各位家长好，我是初一（3）班的新班主任林晓，教语文，之前在城东中学带过两届初中生。我比较看重孩子的阅读习惯，每周五会留一篇短文，读完写三句话就行，不求长。课余我喜欢打羽毛球，孩子们估计很快会在操场上看到我。孩子有什么情况，工作日下午4点后可以直接私信我。
note: 老师面对家长：一件具体的教学安排加一个生活小爱好，再说清楚什么时间怎么联系，比一长串资历更让人放心。

situation: 我叫李晓雯，刚跟老公志强领证，他把我拉进了他们家的家族群，四十多个亲戚，大部分我都没见过。婆婆让我在群里发个自我介绍。我是湖南岳阳人，在长沙教了五年小学英语，平时爱做湘菜。
reply: 各位长辈、兄弟姐妹好，我是志强的爱人李晓雯，刚加入咱们这个大家庭，请大家多关照。我是湖南岳阳人，在长沙一所小学教了五年英语。平时喜欢做饭，湘菜比较拿手，辣度可以按各位口味调。很期待早日见到大家，也想请哪位长辈给我讲讲志强小时候的趣事。
note: 家族群里语气恭敬一些，但仍要留一个能接话的点，比如拿手菜、想听老公小时候的事。

situation: I'm Rosa, a physio. My partner Dev and I moved into flat 3B, in a 12-flat building, on Saturday with our 4-month-old, Isla, and she still cries a lot at night. There's a residents' WhatsApp group. I want to introduce us and give a heads-up about the noise without over-apologising.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Rosa, and my partner Dev and I moved into 3B on Saturday with our daughter Isla, who's four months old. Fair warning that she's still working out the difference between night and day, so you may hear her through the walls for a while; if it's ever keeping you up, just tell me and we'll move her cot to the back room. I'm a physio, so feel free to ask me about stiff backs. And we'd love to know where the best bakery nearby is.
note: A heads-up with a real fix beats an apology; the human hook is what neighbours will greet you with on the stairs.

situation: My old manager Tom introduced me by email to Dr. Aisha Bello, who runs the clinical data team at St Mary's Hospital, mentioning her team's work on outpatient no-shows. I'm Chris Yates, and for three years I've built demand forecasts for 140 stores at Harlow Retail; I want to move into healthcare. I volunteer as a timekeeper at a weekend 5k. I need to reply-all and introduce myself.
reply: Thanks, Tom (moving you to bcc). Hi Dr. Bello, I'm Chris Yates, a data analyst at Harlow Retail, where for the last three years I've built the demand forecasts for our 140 stores. I'm hoping to move into healthcare data, and Tom mentioned your team's work on outpatient no-shows. Outside work I keep time at a weekend 5k, so I'm used to messy timing data in the rain. Would you have 20 minutes for a call in the next few weeks? Any Tuesday or Thursday afternoon works for me.
note: Replying to an introduction: thank the connector once, move them to bcc, and keep the ask small and easy to schedule.

situation: I'm Hannah Obi, an accountant for small charities, and I've just been elected, with one other newcomer, to the nine-person board of our local food co-op. I joined two years ago for the bulk oats and stayed for the Saturday volunteer shifts. At the first meeting, Tuesday Oct 13, the chair wants each new member to introduce themselves in about 30 seconds, and I'd like to learn how the treasurer's reports are prepared.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Hannah Obi, one of the two new board members. By day I'm an accountant for small charities, so I'm happy to be the person who reads the financials closely. I joined the co-op two years ago for the bulk oats and stayed for the Saturday volunteer shifts. Before our next meeting, I'd love 20 minutes with whoever has been preparing the treasurer's reports, so I can learn where the numbers come from.
note: On a board, the concrete thing is the skill you bring, and the invitation is the specific handover you need.

situation: I just joined the Discord for an open-source mapping library I've used at work for two years to draw delivery zones. I'm Inês, a backend developer in Lisbon, I want to contribute but have never done open source, and I surf badly at weekends. Posting in #introductions.
reply: Hi all, I'm Inês, a backend developer in Lisbon. I've used the library at work for two years to draw delivery zones, so I know it well from the user side. I've never contributed to open source and I'd love to start small. Outside work I surf badly every weekend, so I'm used to falling off things. If anyone has a favourite good first issue or a doc page that needs fixing, point me at it.
note: In a contributor community, the invitation is a concrete way in: ask for a first issue, not for attention.

situation: I'm Priya, rejoining my old company on Monday after three years away. I used to be on the analytics team; now I'm a data engineer on the platform team. In between I built data pipelines at a logistics company, and I picked up sourdough baking. About half the Slack channel knows me, half joined after I left.
reply: Hi all, I'm Priya, and some of you will remember me from the analytics team: I'm back after three years away, this time as a data engineer on platform. While I was gone I built data pipelines at a logistics company, so messy shipment data is my happy place. I also picked up sourdough baking, so starter questions welcome. If we haven't met, I'd love 15 minutes to hear what you're working on, and if we have, come tell me what I've missed.
note: A returning hire speaks to both halves of the room: a nod to old colleagues, a proper intro for new ones.

situation: Je m'appelle Claire, je suis kiné et je viens d'emménager de Lille à Annecy. Jeudi, je rejoins une chorale amateur et le chef de chœur demande à chaque nouveau de se présenter en 30 secondes. J'ai chanté alto dix ans à Lille, mais je lis encore mal les partitions.
reply: Bonsoir à tous, je m'appelle Claire, je suis kiné et je viens d'arriver de Lille. J'ai chanté alto pendant dix ans dans une chorale là-bas, donc la voix est là, mais je lis encore mal les partitions. Si une alto accepte que je me place à côté d'elle les premières semaines, je la suivrai de près ! Et comme je ne connais encore personne à Annecy, vos bonnes adresses sont les bienvenues.
note: Le point faible dit simplement devient l'invitation : les altos savent tout de suite comment l'aider.

situation: 我叫林悦，10月9日（周五）去一家车企面试车主App的产品经理，面试官肯定会先让我做一分钟自我介绍。我做了五年电商App产品，去年负责结算页改版，下单转化率提高了12%。平时喜欢骑行，周末常和车友骑一百公里。
reply: 您好，我叫林悦，做了五年电商App的产品经理。去年我负责结算页改版，下单转化率提高了12%，这是我最有成就感的一个项目。工作之外我喜欢骑行，周末常和车友骑一百公里。我很想了解车主App现在最想解决的问题是什么，这也是我今天最想和您聊的。
note: 面试版本：一个有数字的成果，一个让人记住的爱好，结尾把话题交回给面试官。

situation: 我叫孙磊，是新调来的物业管家，从今天起负责5栋到8栋。业主群里有三百多人，之前的管家报修拖拉，大家意见很大。我干物业八年了，自己也住在这个小区的12栋，工作日早8点到晚6点在5栋一楼服务中心。想发个自我介绍。
reply: 各位业主好，我是新来的物业管家孙磊，从今天起负责5栋到8栋。我做物业八年，最看重的是报修有回音：每一单报修，我都会当天回复您处理时间。我自己也住在小区12栋，楼下碰见了随时叫我。工作日早8点到晚6点我在5栋一楼服务中心，报修可以在群里@我，也可以私信。
note: 不提前任，也不承诺修好的速度，只承诺自己能做到的“当天回复”。

situation: 我叫张可，大三学生，今天第一天在一家游戏公司市场部实习，为期三个月，主管让我在部门的企业微信群（四十多人）里做个自我介绍。我学广告，自己运营一个做游戏剪辑的B站账号，有两万粉丝，平时爱打羽毛球。
reply: 各位好，我是市场部新来的实习生张可，大三，学广告，接下来三个月跟着大家学习。我自己在B站做游戏剪辑，有两万粉丝，剪视频、找素材这类活儿随时可以叫我。平时喜欢打羽毛球，公司有球局的话求带上我。新人最该先看哪份资料，欢迎直接甩给我！
note: 实习生的自我介绍不用过度谦虚：给一个具体能帮上忙的点，再留一个容易接话的请求。

situation: I'm Marcus and I've volunteered to coach my son Leo's under-9 football team, 14 kids. First session is Saturday at 10am and the parents will stay to watch, so I'll introduce myself to kids and parents together on the pitch. I played Sunday league for ten years and I work as a paramedic.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Marcus, Leo's dad, and I'm the new coach for the under-9s. I played Sunday league for ten years, and in the week I'm a paramedic, so scraped knees are in safe hands. What I care about most is that everyone gets the ball and has fun. Kids, shout out your favourite player as we warm up; parents, if you'd like to help with cones, come and find me after.
note: Two audiences at once: keep it short enough for the kids and give the parents their own invitation.

situation: I'm Joel, starting Monday 5 October as a QA engineer on a team that's all in Chicago. I'm in Manila, 13 hours ahead, so our overlap is roughly 7 to 9pm Chicago time. I spent four years testing mobile banking apps and I play in a weekend basketball league; I want to post a hello in the team Slack.
reply: Hi all, I'm Joel, joining as a QA engineer today. I'm in Manila, 13 hours ahead of you, so our overlap is roughly 7 to 9pm Chicago time, while you're wrapping up. I spent the last four years testing mobile banking apps, so breaking things on purpose is my happy place. At weekends I play in a basketball league. If there's a bug you'd love someone to finally chase down, drop it in my DMs and I'll have notes waiting when you wake up.
note: Remote in another time zone: give the overlap in their time and turn the gap into something useful to them.

situation: I'm Sofia. I've just moved to Denver for a job as a civil engineer doing bridge inspections, and I've been added to my university's Denver alumni Facebook group, about 300 people. I don't know anyone in the city yet, and I've just started bouldering.
reply: Hi all, I'm Sofia, and I've just moved to Denver to work as a civil engineer doing bridge inspections, so if you've ever wondered whether a bridge is okay, I'm your person. I don't know anyone in the city yet, and I've just started bouldering. If there's an alumni meet-up coming up, or anyone fancies a beginner-friendly climbing session, I'd love to join.
note: With weak ties, one easy invitation gets replies; save asks for jobs or flat leads for later, one to one.

situation: Me llamo Marta y el lunes 5 de octubre empiezo como cuidadora de don Ernesto, de 84 años, de lunes a viernes de 9 a 14. Su hija Pilar me ha añadido al grupo de WhatsApp de la familia, con sus cinco hijos y algunos nietos, para que me presente. Llevo ocho años cuidando a personas mayores, tengo el curso de primeros auxilios y me encanta cocinar.
reply: Hola a todos, soy Marta, y a partir del lunes 5 de octubre acompañaré a don Ernesto de lunes a viernes, de 9 a 14. Llevo ocho años cuidando a personas mayores y tengo el curso de primeros auxilios. Me encanta cocinar, así que si a don Ernesto le apetece algún plato en especial, aquí estoy. Me ayudaría mucho que me contarais qué le gusta, qué le preocupa y cómo le gusta organizar el día; podéis escribirme por aquí cuando queráis. Gracias, Pilar, por añadirme.
note: Con la familia de la persona a la que cuidas, la invitación es pedir lo que ellos saben de él: genera más confianza que el currículum.

situation: Ich heiße Diego, komme aus Mexiko und fange am Montag, 5. Oktober, als Elektriker in einem kleinen Betrieb in Leipzig an, wir sind acht Leute. Mein Deutsch ist ungefähr B1, und ich möchte am ersten Tag in der Frühstückspause kurz etwas sagen. In Mexiko war ich sechs Jahre Elektriker, meistens auf Neubauten, und am Wochenende spiele ich Fußball.
reply: Hallo zusammen, ich bin Diego und ab heute Elektriker hier im Team. Ich komme aus Mexiko und habe dort sechs Jahre als Elektriker gearbeitet, meistens auf Neubauten. Mein Deutsch ist noch nicht perfekt, also sprecht gern etwas langsamer und korrigiert mich ruhig, das hilft mir sehr. Am Wochenende spiele ich Fußball: Wenn jemand eine Mannschaft hat, sagt Bescheid!
note: Wer in einer neuen Sprache anfängt, macht daraus eine Einladung: um langsames Sprechen und Korrekturen bitten, statt sich zu entschuldigen.

situation: I'm Grace. My mum was diagnosed with Alzheimer's in May and moved in with us in August. On Tuesday 6 October I'm joining an online carers' support group for the first time, and everyone introduces themselves for about a minute. I work part-time as a librarian, gardening is how I unwind, and the hardest part right now is the evenings, when Mum gets confused about where she is.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Grace. My mum was diagnosed with Alzheimer's in May and moved in with us in August, so I'm very new to this. I work part-time as a librarian, and gardening is how I unwind. The hardest part for me right now is the evenings, when Mum gets confused about where she is, so I'd really love to hear how others handle that.
note: In a support group the reason you're there is the concrete thing, and the invitation is the one thing you most want help with.

situation: I'm Ana Ribeiro and I've just bought Maple Street Laundry from Mr Chen, who ran it for 22 years and retired at the end of September. Prices stay the same until the end of December, and card payments start on Monday 12 October. I was a nurse for ten years, and I want to email the 300 customers on Mr Chen's mailing list and put the same note on the door.
reply: Hello, I'm Ana Ribeiro, and I'm the new owner of Maple Street Laundry. Mr Chen ran it for 22 years and retired at the end of September, so I have big shoes to fill. Prices stay exactly the same until the end of December, and from Monday 12 October you'll be able to pay by card as well. Before this I was a nurse for ten years, so tumble dryers are a gentle change of pace. If there's one thing you'd keep exactly as Mr Chen had it, or one thing you'd change, I'd love to hear it: reply to this email or tell me in person.
note: Taking over a business: tell regulars what stays the same before what changes, and ask them for the one thing they care about.

situation: 我叫王建国，46岁，开了二十年货车，今年考上了开放大学的会计专业。班级微信群有80人，大多是二十多岁的年轻人，班主任让大家发自我介绍。我数学底子弱，但跑车时自己记了二十年账，平时爱钓鱼。
reply: 大家好，我是王建国，今年46岁，开了二十年货车，现在来学会计，算是班里的“老”同学了。跑车那些年我自己记了二十年的账，所以对数字不怕，就是数学底子弱，以后少不了请教大家。平时爱钓鱼，周边哪儿有好钓点可以问我。谁要组学习小组，算我一个！
note: 年纪大的新同学：一句话说清来历，一个具体长处、一个坦白的短板，再给年轻同学一个容易接话的邀请。

situation: 我叫郑一帆，在义乌做宠物用品出口七年，主要做欧洲市场，最近在研究开美国站，美国那边的物流和退货还摸不清。朋友把我拉进一个480人的跨境电商卖家交流群，群规禁止发广告和二维码。我平时爱跑马拉松。
reply: 大家好，我是郑一帆，在义乌做宠物用品出口七年，主要做欧洲市场。最近在研究开美国站，那边的物流和退货怎么处理还摸不太清，有经验的朋友想请教一二；欧洲站的问题也欢迎来找我聊，知道的都分享。平时爱跑马拉松，义乌的跑友可以约起来。
note: 同行交流群里不发广告：说清做什么、想请教什么、能分享什么，以交换代替推销。

situation: I'm Sina, 20, from Hamburg, and I've been matched as an au pair with Rachel and Tom Morgan in Seattle, looking after Ava (7) and Ben (4) from Monday 2 November. I've coached children's swimming for three years and I play the ukulele badly. I want to send my first email to the parents before I arrive.
reply: Hi Rachel and Tom, I'm Sina, and I'm so happy to be joining your family as Ava and Ben's au pair from Monday 2 November. For the last three years I've coached children's swimming in Hamburg, so I'm used to wet towels and lots of energy. I also play the ukulele, badly, but kids usually don't mind. Before I arrive, I'd love to hear what a normal day looks like for Ava and Ben, and what they're into right now. Best, Sina
note: Before a live-in role, make the invitation a question about the children's routine: it shows you're already thinking about them.

situation: I'm Amara Diallo, a second-year nursing student, and my university's mentoring scheme has matched me with Dr Helen Fry, an intensive care consultant. Before uni I worked for two years as a healthcare assistant on a stroke ward, I'm hoping to go into critical care, and I sing in a gospel choir. I'm free for a first call any Tuesday or Thursday after 4pm and want to send her my first email.
reply:
Dear Dr Fry,
I'm Amara Diallo, a second-year nursing student, and I'm delighted to have been matched with you through the mentoring scheme. Before university I spent two years as a healthcare assistant on a stroke ward, which is where I first got curious about critical care. Outside placements I sing in a gospel choir. I'd love to hear how you came into intensive care; would you have time for a first call? I'm free any Tuesday or Thursday after 4pm.
Best wishes,
Amara
note: With an assigned mentor, the invitation is a small first step that is easy to say yes to; one human line keeps it from reading like a CV.

situation: Sou a Camila, analista de compras há quatro anos numa empresa em Curitiba. Hoje começou a nova gerente do setor, a Juliana, que veio de outra empresa. Cuido dos contratos com os 30 fornecedores de embalagem, em julho renegociei o frete com economia de 8%, e nos fins de semana faço trilhas. Quero me apresentar a ela por mensagem no Teams.
reply: Oi, Juliana, seja bem-vinda! Sou a Camila, analista de compras aqui há quatro anos. Cuido dos contratos com os 30 fornecedores de embalagem, e em julho renegociei o frete com uma economia de 8%, então, se quiser um panorama dos fornecedores, é só pedir. Nos fins de semana costumo fazer trilhas por aqui. Quando tiver um tempinho nesta semana, adoraria 20 minutos para te contar como as coisas funcionam e ouvir o que é prioridade para você.
note: Para uma nova gestora, o útil é dizer o que você cuida e oferecer contexto; o convite é ouvir as prioridades dela.

situation: I'm Leah, joining the comms team at a housing charity on Monday as maternity cover for Sarah, who's back next July. I've done six years of comms for a hospice, mostly press and fundraising appeals, and I swim in the sea all year round. Sarah has left me a handover doc, and I want to post a hello in the team Slack channel on my first day.
reply: Hi all, I'm Leah, and I'm covering Sarah's role on the comms team until she's back in July. I've spent six years doing comms for a hospice, mostly press and fundraising appeals, so that side of the work is familiar ground. I've got Sarah's handover doc, and my aim is to keep things running the way she set them up, not to reinvent them. Outside work I swim in the sea all year round, yes, even in January. If there's something in Sarah's patch you rely on that might not be in the doc, I'd love to hear it.
note: Maternity cover: say it's temporary and that you're keeping her work going, so the team doesn't brace for change.

situation: I'm Ruth Okonkwo, and on Monday I start as CFO of Alder & Pine, a furniture maker with about 400 staff; the CEO wants me to say hello for about a minute on Thursday's all-hands video call. I spent 12 years in finance at a hospital group, where my proudest project was cutting the time we took to pay suppliers from 60 days to 30. I'm a keen but average amateur cellist, and I want people to feel they can bring me money questions without it being scary.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Ruth Okonkwo, and I joined this week as CFO. I spent the last 12 years in finance at a hospital group, and the project I'm proudest of there was getting our suppliers paid in 30 days instead of 60. Outside work I play the cello, keenly rather than well. Over the next month I'd love to hear from anyone who's ever thought finance makes their job harder than it needs to be; my inbox is open, and no question is too small.
note: A senior hello to a big room: one result people can picture, one human line, and an invitation that makes you easy to approach.

situation: 我叫何静，刚从上海总部调到成都分公司当市场部经理，部门二十来个人。周六部门聚餐，总经理让我举杯说几句，算是正式自我介绍。我在总部做了六年品牌，重庆人，特别能吃辣；下周想跟每位同事单独喝杯茶聊聊。
reply: 各位好，我是何静，这次从上海总部调过来，跟大家一起在市场部干活。之前我在总部做了六年品牌，来了以后最想先听听大家在一线碰到的真实情况。我是重庆人，吃辣应该不会给成都丢脸，好吃的馆子欢迎推荐。下周我想约每位同事单独喝杯茶，聊聊你们手上的事。先敬大家一杯，以后请多关照！
note: 饭桌上的自我介绍要短：一个具体的工作背景、一个能接话的生活点、一个下周就能兑现的邀请，敬酒收尾。

situation: I'm Mei, starting a 16-week returnship as a structural engineer at Halloway Partners on Monday, after six years at home with my two kids. Before the break I designed school buildings for eight years. I want to post a hello in the team's Teams channel; I'm a bit nervous about how much the design software has changed, and I've taken up open-water swimming this year.
reply: Hi all, I'm Mei, joining the structures team today on the 16-week returnship. Before a six-year break at home with my two kids, I spent eight years designing school buildings, so anything with classrooms and stairwells has my attention. The design software has moved on a lot since then, so I'd love to hear which tools you lean on most, and who doesn't mind the odd question. Outside work I've taken up open-water swimming this year. Looking forward to meeting you all.
note: A career break gets one plain line, no apology; turning the gap into a question gives people an easy way to help.
